extracted.intended_audience: organizations, communicators, marketers, researchers, and professionals seeking data visualization and infographic design services
extracted.subtask_description: A commercial service offering for designing data visualizations, infographics, presentations, social media graphics, printed materials, and related consulting/workshops to improve internal and external visual communication. The page lists deliverable types, formats, and supporting activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improve visual communication (internal and external)
rubrics_metrics.description: Your Data, Better Design — InfoNewt is focused on improving visual communication, both internal and external, by using innovative data visualization and infographic design techniques.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Designs should improve how data and stories are communicated to internal stakeholders and external audiences; emphasis on clarity and innovation. Founder credibility (Randy Krum, author of Cool Infographics) supports this mission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of visual elements (charts, illustrations, diagrams, maps, complex representations)
rubrics_metrics.description: These designs can include charts, illustrations, diagrams, maps, and complex representations of data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select appropriate visual elements to represent the data and story; combine multiple element types when necessary to convey complexity while maintaining readability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data Visualizations
rubrics_metrics.description: Data Visualizations — how the client's data is visually represented.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on accurate, effective charting and visual encodings to tell the data story. Consider intended audience and the message when choosing visualization types.

rubrics_metrics.name: Infographics (design, publication, promotion, tracking)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide end-to-end infographic production: creative design, preparation for publication, strategies for promotion, and methods to track performance/engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Presentations (PowerPoint, Keynote, Prezi)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design slide decks tailored to the platform and audience; prioritize clear storytelling, visual hierarchy, and slide-level data visualization where needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promotion & Outreach
rubrics_metrics.description: Promotion & Outreach — services to help disseminate visual content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan and execute outreach strategies to increase visibility and engagement of visual pieces across appropriate channels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social Media Graphics (mini infographics, photo overlays, mobile)
rubrics_metrics.description: Social Media Graphics — Mini Infographics | Photo Overlays | Mobile.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design graphics optimized for social platforms and mobile viewing; consider brevity, legibility at small sizes, and shareability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Infographic Resumes
rubrics_metrics.description: Infographic Resumes — visually designed resumes using infographic techniques.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Translate a professional's experience and skills into an engaging, scannable infographic resume that communicates strengths quickly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reports & White Papers (charts, diagrams, maps, illustrations)
rubrics_metrics.description: Reports & White Papers — Charts | Diagrams | Maps | Illustrations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Integrate data visuals and illustrations into long-form documents to clarify findings and highlight key points while maintaining publication standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Printed Designs (handouts, posters, brochures, banners)
rubrics_metrics.description: Printed Designs — Handouts | Posters | Brochures | Banners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare print-ready artwork that considers layout, resolution, and production constraints; tailor design to distribution context (events, handouts, signage).

rubrics_metrics.name: Consulting & Workshops (idea generation, design feedback, training, storytelling)
rubrics_metrics.description: Consulting & Workshops — Idea Gen | Design Feedback | Training | Storytelling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offer strategic services: brainstorm visual storytelling approaches, critique and improve existing designs, train teams on visualization best practices, and teach narrative techniques for data.
